hooks.command: git fetch origin --quiet 2>/dev/null; AHEAD=$(git rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 0); BEHIND=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/main 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$AHEAD" != "0" ] || [ "$BEHIND" != "0" ]; then echo "Sync check: $AHEAD unpushed commit(s), $BEHIND commit(s) waiting on main. Before finishing: update .team/<you>.md, run bun run test && bun run typecheck, then git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin main."; fi
